def VTask.evenOddRec : {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} -> (h0 : P 0) -> (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) -> (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) -> (n : ℕ) -> P n :=
  fun h0 h_even h_odd n =>
    let rec aux (n : ℕ) (acc : P 0) : P n :=
      match n with
      | 0 => acc
      | succ k =>
        if k % 2 = 0 then
          aux (k / 2) (h_even k acc)
        else
          aux (k / 2) (h_odd k acc)
    aux n h0
